name: record-list-item-only
body: A `record` is a list's item descriptor, never a field's `type:`. An inline record is declared in a list's `item:` descriptor — `item: {type: record, fields: [...]}` (record-item-type) — and a field descriptor whose `type:` is `record`, at a template's top level or inside a record's `fields:`, is a templates error naming the field path. A record nests by making one of its fields a list whose item is a record.
